frame: x east, y north, cm, z up
local_frame: prop-local, Unreal axes: X forward, Y right, Z up, cm; pivot at the base centre. OBJ files store (x, -y, z) of these coordinates with counter-clockwise outward winding, the Scripts/plateau_mesh.py file convention, so Unreal's OBJ import restores them. Yaw = atan2(dy, dx) of the game-frame facing direction.

lamp_cobra.description: Montréal residential cobra-head street light: galvanised tapered pole, davit arm over the roadway (+X), flat-lens 3000 K LED head, mounting height about 8.1 m.
lamp_cobra.pivot: pole base centre; arm and head reach +X (toward the road)

lamp_park.description: Parc La Fontaine path lamp: black cast base, fluted shaft, collar and a white globe, about 4.1 m.

hydrant.description: Montréal fire hydrant (borne-fontaine): red octagonal barrel and bonnet, pentagon operating nut, two hose outlets and a front pumper outlet, with the red perforated marker post (separate part).
hydrant.pivot: barrel base centre; pumper outlet faces +X

sign_stop.description: Québec ARRÊT stop sign: 75 cm red octagon with white border and white ARRÊT lettering on a galvanised square post; the face looks along +X.
sign_stop.pivot: post base centre; sign face normal +X (toward approaching traffic)

sign_street.description: Montréal street-name sign: white two-faced blades with a thin black border and a red rosette placeholder at the right end of each face, on a galvanised post. Blade A (along Y, read from ±X) sits above blade B (along X, read from ±Y). The text area is left blank; the apply step adds black text per corner (see text_slots).
sign_street.pivot: post base centre; blade A faces ±X, blade B faces ±Y

text_style.rule: small generic (Rue, Avenue) above a large specific name; keep Est/Ouest; shrink the specific to fit its width

sign_oneway.description: Québec one-way sign: black two-faced plate with a white arrow and a thin white border, on a galvanised post. The arrow points along Unreal local +Y.
sign_oneway.pivot: post base centre; plate faces ±X; arrow toward Unreal +Y (yaw = traffic heading - 90°)

sign_parking.description: Montréal parking sign (R-PF): white plate, red circle and slash over a black P, "9h-23h / EXCEPTÉ S3R" and a direction arrow, on a galvanised post.
sign_parking.text: \P 9h-23h EXCEPTE S3R (dataset code R-PF, the commonest Plateau parking sign)

bixi_dock.description: BIXI station segment: low grey platform with six docking posts, a tall pay terminal with a dark station-name header, screen and red mark, and a black solar pole with two panels. Bikes dock nose-first against the posts (see slots).
bixi_dock.pivot: platform centre on the ground; slots in a row along Y; bikes extend toward +X

bixi_bike.description: BIXI city bike: silver-grey step-through aluminium frame, front rack with a red BIXI panel, full fenders, chain guard and black tyres.
bixi_bike.pivot: midpoint between the tyre contact points; front wheel toward +X

bin_recycling.description: Montréal blue recycling wheelie bin (bac roulant bleu, 240 L): tapered body, hinged lid with front lip, rear wheels and handle, white recycling arrows.
bin_recycling.pivot: base centre; front with the arrows faces +X; wheels and handle at -X

bin_compost.description: Montréal brown organics bin (bac brun, 45 L): tapered body, lid with the locking carry handle across it and a front latch.

bin_garbage.description: Curbside pile of three tied black garbage bags.

cone.description: Montréal orange traffic cone, 71 cm, with two white reflective bands and a black square base.

barrier_chantier.description: Chantier barrier panel: 2 m orange frame on black rubber feet with orange-and-white diagonal striped boards and an amber flasher.
barrier_chantier.pivot: base centre; boards span Y; faces ±X

utility_pole.description: Wooden ruelle utility pole, 10.5 m, with a crossarm, braces, four green glass pin insulators, a secondary rack with spool insulators and an ID tag.
utility_pole.pivot: pole base centre; crossarm along Y
utility_pole.wire_note: sag wires 2-4 % of the span between neighbouring poles; galleries at 6-8 m

laundry_line.description: Montréal pulley clothesline (corde à linge): two pulleys, a looped line 6 m long with gentle sag and garments pinned on the lower line (flat cards).
laundry_line.pivot: bounding-box base centre; the line runs along X; anchors give the pulley axles
laundry_line.scale_note: scale X by span/600 between 0.7 and 1.4; place anchors on a gallery post and a pole

bike_locked.description: City bike leaning 9° toward Unreal -Y (its left) against a post or railing, with a yellow U-lock through the frame and rear wheel.
bike_locked.pivot: midpoint between the tyre contact points; front wheel +X; lean contact toward Unreal -Y

ac_unit.description: Window air conditioner: beige-white case, dark front grille with louvres, top vents, pleated side panels and two steel support brackets.
ac_unit.pivot: bounding-box base centre; grille faces +X; the window plane is at anchors.wall_plane_x_cm
ac_unit.mount_note: sits on the sill of an upper window; x < wall_plane is inside the window

flower_box.description: Window flower box: painted wooden planter with soil, leaves and geranium-like flowers, on two iron brackets.
flower_box.pivot: bounding-box base centre; front +X; back against the wall at anchors.wall_plane_x_cm

bench.description: Montréal park bench: dark cast-iron ends with armrests and wooden seat and back slats, 1.8 m.

mailbox.description: Generic red street letter box (Canada Post style, no logo): rounded top, front slot with a pull flap, white collection-times plate, black plinth.

police_lightbar.description: Generic police light bar: black base, red lenses on the driver side (Unreal -Y, the car's left), blue on the right, clear centre module, roof feet.
police_lightbar.pivot: base centre on the roof; long axis Y; front +X

dog_small.description: Leashed dog, small terrier: articulated parts (body, head, four legs, tail) with joint pivots for procedural trot, plus merged meshes for static use.
dog_small.pivot: ground under the body centre; nose toward +X
dog_small.trot: swing legs about Unreal Y with diagonal pairs in phase (fl+rr, fr+rl); stride period about 0.45 s at walking pace

dog_medium.description: Leashed dog, medium beagle/collie type: articulated parts (body, head, four legs, tail) with joint pivots for procedural trot, plus merged meshes for static use.
dog_medium.pivot: ground under the body centre; nose toward +X
dog_medium.trot: swing legs about Unreal Y with diagonal pairs in phase (fl+rr, fr+rl); stride period about 0.45 s at walking pace

dog_large.description: Leashed dog, large retriever type: articulated parts (body, head, four legs, tail) with joint pivots for procedural trot, plus merged meshes for static use.
dog_large.pivot: ground under the body centre; nose toward +X
dog_large.trot: swing legs about Unreal Y with diagonal pairs in phase (fl+rr, fr+rl); stride period about 0.45 s at walking pace

stroller.description: City stroller: dark aluminium frame with handlebar, fabric seat and basket, folding canopy and four wheels (separate parts with axle pivots).
stroller.pivot: ground under the frame centre; pushed toward +X; handlebar at -X

grocery_bag.description: Kraft paper grocery bag with twisted handles, a baguette and leeks sticking out.

chair_patio.description: Moulded resin stacking armchair (the monobloc patio chair): splayed legs, seat at 44 cm, slatted back, arms at 63 cm.

bbq.description: Two-burner propane grill on a cart: black hood and firebox, steel side shelves and control panel with knobs, a white 20 lb propane tank on the bottom shelf, two wheels.

satellite_dish.description: Small offset satellite dish (about 50 x 46 cm, the Bell or Shaw kind): grey reflector tilted up, LNB on its arm, on a short mast with a clamp for a gallery guard cap rail or a wall.
satellite_dish.pivot: bottom of the clamp plate; anchors.clamp_cm is the clamp centre (set it on the rail top); the dish faces +X (aim it south-southwest)
satellite_dish.mount_note: clamp on a gallery guard cap rail (top of the 107 cm guard) or screw to a wall; yaw +X toward 190-230 degrees azimuth (Bell 91 W, Shaw 107.3 W from Montreal)

potted_plant.description: Terracotta pot on a saucer with a geranium past its season: a loose mound of leaves, a few late flowers and some yellowing stems.
potted_plant.season_note: late October: the PlantDry and PlantRust variants read as frost-bitten

bike_gallery.description: Commuter bike stored on a back gallery, leaning 12 degrees toward Unreal -Y (its left) against the guard: fenders, a rear rack and a wire front basket.
bike_gallery.pivot: midpoint between the tyre contact points; front wheel +X; lean contact toward Unreal -Y

leaf_bag.description: Kraft paper yard-waste bag (full), the 30 gallon two-ply lawn and leaf bag: 41 x 30 cm, filled to 64 cm, the side gussets tucked in and the top folded over, a green leaf print on both wide faces and a few leaves caught in the fold.
leaf_bag.pivot: base centre; wide faces look along ±X
leaf_bag.placement_note: on the sidewalk at the curb edge beside the bins of a collection row, or against a front fence or stoop: one to four per door, a wide face toward the street; pick the form by the forms shares and the colour by variant_seed (fresh, rain-dark, sun-bleached kraft)

leaf_bag_mid.description: Kraft paper yard-waste bag (three quarters), the 30 gallon two-ply lawn and leaf bag: 41 x 30 cm, filled to 48 cm, the side gussets tucked in and the top folded over, a green leaf print on both wide faces and a few leaves caught in the fold.
leaf_bag_mid.pivot: base centre; wide faces look along ±X

leaf_bag_low.description: Kraft paper yard-waste bag (half), the 30 gallon two-ply lawn and leaf bag: 41 x 30 cm, filled to 32 cm, the side gussets tucked in and the top folded over, a green leaf print on both wide faces and a few leaves caught in the fold.
leaf_bag_low.pivot: base centre; wide faces look along ±X

pumpkin.description: Carving pumpkin with ten ribs and a woody stem, about 30 cm across.
pumpkin.placement_note: on stoop steps and landings, front-yard ledges and balcony floors: one to three per door, sizes by the placement scale (pie .6, carving 1, large 1.4), a carved one with its face (+X) toward the sidewalk; the colour by variant_seed (orange, deep orange, white)

pumpkin_carved.description: Carving pumpkin with ten ribs and a woody stem, about 30 cm across, carved as a jack-o'-lantern: triangle eyes and nose, a grin with two teeth and the lid cut, facing +X.
pumpkin_carved.pivot: base centre; the face looks along +X
